input.quote: (i) This Agreement is intended for the sole and exclusive benefit of the Parties hereto, is not intended to confer any rights or benefits on any third party, and only the Parties may enforce such Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement has no insurance clause: a full-text search for "insurance" returned no hits, and a read of all 75 paragraphs confirms General Provisions (Section 14, p0063-p0073) runs from governing law through counterparts with no insurance covenant. Kubient is a hosting/services vendor that operates the Auction Platform and, under Section 9(b)(iii) (p0035), "collect[s], maintain[s], manage[s] and stor[es] ... visitor information (data)" — i.e. it processes our data, which is the trigger for cyber cover under the rule and squarely outside the walk-away position. It also gives broad indemnities in Section 10(a) (p0047-p0051) covering the Services, the Auction Platform and third-party Creative, which are unsupported by any insurance backstop, particularly given the mutual consequential-damages waiver in Section 7(a) (p0027). Inserted a single new subsection (j) after p0073 in the existing General Provisions section — the smallest edit reaching the preferred position — requiring CGL of USD 1M/2M, E&O of USD 2M, cyber/privacy of USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, additional-insured status on the CGL policy, and certificates on request. Fallback of E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant (CGL, E&O, cyber, workers' comp) as new General Provisions subsection (j).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no insurance covenant, so we have added a short one in General Provisions requiring commercial general liability (USD 1M/2M), professional liability/E&O (USD 2M), cyber and privacy liability (USD 5M) and statutory workers' compensation, with certificates on request. Kubient hosts the Auction Platform and, per Section 9(b)(iii), collects and stores visitor data, so cyber cover is essential to give the indemnities in Section 10 real financial backing; if helpful we can accept E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber of USD 2,000,000 as a fallback.

ops.text: (j) Kubient shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the Term and for one (1) year thereafter: (i) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (ii) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (iii) cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000, covering Kubient's collection, maintenance, management and storage of visitor information (data) and Customer's Confidential Information; and (iv) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable Law. Each policy shall be placed with insurers of recognized financial responsibility. Kubient shall name Customer as an additional insured on the commercial general liability policy to the extent of Kubient's indemnification obligations hereunder, and shall provide certificates of insurance to Customer upon request.
